description: Acuvim-L series multifunction power meters (AL, BL, CL, DL, EL, KL), RS485 Modbus RTU
source: Accuenergy, "Acuvim-L Series Power Meter User's Manual" 1030E2202, V2.0.3 (December 2025), section 4.5

sources.title: Acuvim-L Series Power Meter User's Manual

notes: Acuvim-L series (AL, BL, CL, DL, EL, KL); not every model has every value (THD and harmonics need the higher models, TOU the EL/KL).
FC03 reads, FC16 writes; big endian, high word first. The primary values from 0x600 are floats in V, A, W, var and VA.
The integer basic values from 0x130 are on the secondary side: multiply voltages by PT1/PT2, currents by CT1/CT2 and powers by both.
Energies are counts of 0.1 kWh (kvarh, kVAh). Max/min values carry their time as year, month, day, hour, minute and second bytes.
The TOU season, schedule and holiday tables from 0x820 are in the manual and not in this map.
